entries.title: John 13:1
segments: And before the feast of the Passover, when Jesus knew that His hour had come when He should depart out of this world to the Father, having loved [His] own in the world, He loved them to [the] end.

entries.title: John 13:2
segments: And when supper had ended, the Devil now having put into the heart of Judas Iscariot [the son] of Simon to betray Him,

entries.title: John 13:3
segments: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into [His] hands, and that He had come from God and went to God,

entries.title: John 13:4
segments: He rose up from supper and laid aside [His] garments. And He took a towel and girded Himself.

entries.title: John 13:5
segments: After that He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe [them] with the towel with which He was girded.

entries.title: John 13:6
segments: Then He came to Simon Peter. And Peter said to Him, Lord, do You wash my feet?

entries.title: John 13:7
segments: Jesus answered and said to him, You do not know what I do now, but you shall know hereafter.

entries.title: John 13:8
segments: Peter said to Him, You shall never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.

entries.title: John 13:9
segments: Simon Peter said to Him, Lord, not my feet only, but also [my] hands and head.

entries.title: John 13:10
segments: Jesus said to him, He who is bathed has no need except to wash [his] feet, but is clean every whit. And you are clean, but not all.

entries.title: John 13:11
segments: For He knew who would betray Him. Therefore He said, You are not all clean.

entries.title: John 13:12
segments: So after He had washed their feet and had taken His garments and had reclined again, He said to them, Do you know what I have done to you?

entries.title: John 13:13
segments: You call Me the Teacher, and Lord, and you say well, for I AM.

entries.title: John 13:14
segments: If then I, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another's feet.

entries.title: John 13:15
segments: For I have given you an example, that you should do as I have done to you.

entries.title: John 13:16
segments: Truly, truly, I say to you, A servant is not greater than his master, neither is he who is sent greater than he who sent him.

entries.title: John 13:17
segments: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

entries.title: John 13:18
segments: I do not speak of you all; I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture might be fulfilled, "He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me."

entries.title: John 13:19
segments: From now I tell you before [it] comes, so that when it happens you may believe that I AM.

entries.title: John 13:20
segments: Truly, truly, I say to you, He who receives whomever I send receives Me. And he who receives Me receives Him who sent Me.

entries.title: John 13:21
segments: When Jesus had said this, He was troubled in spirit, and testified and said, Truly, truly, I say to you that one of you shall betray Me.

entries.title: John 13:22
segments: Then the disciples looked upon one another, wondering of whom He spoke.

entries.title: John 13:23
segments: But there was one of His disciples leaning upon Jesus' bosom, the one whom Jesus loved.

entries.title: John 13:24
segments: Simon Peter therefore signaled to him to ask whom it might be of whom He spoke.

entries.title: John 13:25
segments: And lying on Jesus' breast, he said to him, Lord, who is it?

entries.title: John 13:26
segments: Jesus answered, It is he to whom I shall give the morsel when I have dipped [it]. And dipping the morsel, He gave [it] to Judas Iscariot, the [son] of Simon.

entries.title: John 13:27
segments: And after the morsel, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, What you do, do quickly.

entries.title: John 13:28
segments: But no one reclining knew for what [reason] He spoke this to him.

entries.title: John 13:29
segments: For some thought, because Judas had the moneybag, that Jesus had said to him, Buy what we have need [of] for the feast; or that he should give something to the poor.

entries.title: John 13:30
segments: He then, having received the morsel, went out immediately. And it was night.

entries.title: John 13:31
segments: Then when he had left, Jesus said, Now the Son of man is glorified, and God is glorified in him.

entries.title: John 13:32
segments: If God is glorified in Him, God shall also glorify Him in Himself, and shall immediately glorify Him.

entries.title: John 13:33
segments: Little children, I am with you yet a little while. You shall seek Me; and as I said to the Jews, Where I go, you cannot come, so I now say to you.

entries.title: John 13:34
segments: I give you a new commandment, that you love one another. As I have loved you, you should also love one another.

entries.title: John 13:35
segments: By this all shall know that you are My disciples, if you have love toward one another.

entries.title: John 13:36
segments: Simon Peter said to Him, Lord, where do You go? Jesus answered him, Where I go you cannot now follow Me, but you shall follow Me afterward.

entries.title: John 13:37
segments: Peter said to Him, Lord, why cannot I follow You now? I will lay down my life for Your sake.

entries.title: John 13:38
segments: Jesus answered him, Will you lay down your life for My sake? Truly, truly, I say to you, The cock shall not crow until you have denied Me three times.
